createTable.remarks: A user's round of the compass; answers hang off it and it freezes immutably once completed

column.name: user_id
column.remarks: The user this attempt belongs to; a raw reference to TH_USER_PROFILE (no JPA association) keeping SFC free of HowiBuy persistence code

column.name: status
column.remarks: The lifecycle state (AttemptStatus enum name): IN_PROGRESS or COMPLETED

column.name: completed_at
column.remarks: When the attempt was locked; null while IN_PROGRESS

createTable.remarks: One user's answer to one question within an attempt

column.name: attempt_id
column.remarks: The attempt this answer belongs to; part of the primary key

column.name: question_id
column.remarks: The question being answered; part of the primary key

changeSet.author: nikospara
changeSet.comment: At most one in-progress attempt per user: a partial unique index, since only IN_PROGRESS rows are constrained (completed attempts accumulate freely).
changeSet.sql: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX UQ_TH_SFC_ATTEMPT__ONE_IN_PROGRESS ON TH_SFC_ATTEMPT (user_id) WHERE status = 'IN_PROGRESS'
ALTER TABLE TH_SFC_ANSWER ADD CONSTRAINT CK_TH_SFC_ANSWER__VALUE_RANGE CHECK (value BETWEEN 1 AND 5)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE TH_SFC_ANSWER DROP CONSTRAINT CK_TH_SFC_ANSWER__VALUE_RANGE
